arStrings.szText:
{c_important}Cursed Machines{/c} have a chance to appear while exploring the Pit.

{c_important}Cursed Machines{/c} cost {u}{b}{c_important}Artificers Stones{/c}{/b}{/u} to activate. Activating one will grant you valuable materials and attract vicious enemies.

The more {c_important}Cursed Machines{/c} you find in a single Pit run, the more lucrative the rewards will become.
